module_title: Introduction to Regional Blocs and Membership
introduction: Regional Blocs are groups of countries that join together to make trade easier (by reducing taxes) and increase economic cooperation. We will study the three most influential groups globally.

core_concepts.title: BRICS
core_concepts.description: An acronym for five of the world's fastest-growing economies: B-Brazil, R-Russia, I-India, C-China, and S-South Africa (joined in 2010). The term 'BRIC' was first coined in 2001 by Goldman Sachs economist 'Jim O'Neill'.

core_concepts.title: ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations)
core_concepts.description: Established in 1967 via the 'Bangkok Declaration'. It consists of 10 countries in Southeast Asia (e.g., Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam, Thailand). Its headquarters is located in 'Jakarta, Indonesia'.

core_concepts.title: G20 (Group of 20)
core_concepts.description: A group of the world's 19 largest economies plus the European Union (EU) and the African Union (AU). It represents 85% of global GDP and 75% of global trade. Critically, the G20 has 'No Permanent Headquarters'.

important_entities.name: BRICS Expansion (2024)
important_entities.significance: As of January 1, 2024, four new members officially joined BRICS: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, and the United Arab Emirates (UAE). This is the most critical current affairs point for exams regarding BRICS.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: Is India a member of ASEAN?
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: This is a common exam trap. India is NOT a member of ASEAN. India is a South Asian country, while ASEAN is for 'South-East' Asian nations. India is a member of SAARC and BIMSTEC.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: T-Thailand, V-Vietnam, C-Cambodia, L-Laos, I-Indonesia, P-Philippines, M-Malaysia, B-Brunei, B-Burma (Myanmar), S-Singapore.

exam_strategy_tips: Direct Question: 'Who coined the term BRIC?' Answer: Jim O'Neill. 'Which city is the HQ of ASEAN?' Answer: Jakarta.
